review.tagline: Routes AI coding agents to reverse-engineering and pentest playbooks
review.summary: reverse-skill is a skill/routing package for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) that, when the agent hits an APK, binary, obfuscated JS, CTF challenge or pentest target, picks the right methodology and tool (jadx, apktool, Frida, IDA, radare2, Ghidra, BurpSuite) instead of guessing commands. Routing is driven by a single JSON config (43-44 rules) validated by a 173-case regression suite and CI on Windows and Ubuntu, covering mobile, firmware, malware, pwn, EDR bypass and API security.
review.audience: Security researchers using AI coding agents for reverse engineering and CTF
strengths: Client-neutral routing core works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
Single routing.json source of truth with a 173-case regression benchmark run in CI
Covers a wide scenario matrix: APK, iOS, .NET, JS, firmware, pwn, EDR bypass, CTF
Includes case/evidence workflow (scope, timeline, findings) not just tool dispatch
weaknesses: Core scripts are PowerShell-based, with separate bash variants for Linux/macOS/Kali
Requires external install of Java/JDK, Node.js 22.12+, Python 3.x and the RE tools themselves
CTF-Sandbox-Orchestrator submodule is GPLv3, mixed licensing alongside the MIT core
A routing layer, not an RE engine itself, so it depends on tools already being installed
needs: Needs Java/JDK, Node.js 22.12+, Python 3.x, jadx, apktool, Frida, IDA Pro, radare2, Ghidra, Binary Ninja
